newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen to expand telecommunications unit.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen to expand telecommunications unit.

text.p: German engineering group Thyssen AG plans to expand its telecommunications business, despite early losses, management board chairman Dieter Vogel said on Sunday in an interview with the news magazine Focus.

In the interview, released ahead of publication on Monday, Vogel said the group would expand its E-Plus mobile phone network and denied that utility Veba AG would take over Thyssen's share in the network.
Both Veba and Thyssen are joint shareholders in E-Plus. Vogel also said he was sticking to his plan to launch Thyssen Telecom on the stock market in 1999.
Thyssen said on Friday it had incurred expected losses in its telecoms business in the last business year, but did not reveal what those losses were.
